Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 20 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Enhanced Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 2:00 AM, 20 July 2025(Sunday)

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Metro Manila, Rizal, Bataan, Bulacan, Zambales and Pampanga.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is still THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Cavite, Batangas, Laguna, Quezon and Tarlac.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Nueva Ecija which may persist within 3 hours.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 5:00 AM today.

For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.

In the Philippines, there is one great businessman I look up to. His name is Ramon S. Ang. He is the owner of San Miguel and also a fan of automotive.

I call him Sir Ang.

One time, I called his office. He wasn’t there, so I only got to speak with his staff. I told them I just needed five minutes of his time—I had a few questions. He had a very busy schedule at that time, so the secretary said she would confirm the schedule. I took it as a decline.

A few hours later, I decided to go out and headed to the grocery store. That’s when I noticed Sir Ang had already sent his men to inspect every drainage I would pass by—just to make sure there would be no flooding in my area.

That’s a true story, just in case you’re wondering.

I just remembered it today, when I opened my computer and read a few lines from an author I adore. Great men always have a way to hold you—even from a distance.
